item.text: {"actions":[{"action":"Freeze session membership at a committed watermark.","mechanism":"Promise exactly IDs created by watermark W and not deleted by W; payloads remain current, not historical.","implementation":"Persist birth and deletion versions; publish W only after all changes through W are visible. Restrict membership filters to immutable fields.","check":"Capture expected membership at W. Later inserts must be absent; later deletions must remain represented by their IDs.","risk":"Per-record versions alone cannot establish a global committed watermark."},{"action":"Replace offsets with a stable seek cursor.","mechanism":"An exclusive creation-timestamp-and-ID boundary prevents position shifts; immutable IDs break timestamp ties.","implementation":"Index the ordering pair. Query membership at W strictly after the cursor pair, ordered ascending; advance using the last returned entry.","check":"Insert and delete around page boundaries, including equal timestamps. Concatenated pages must equal the expected ordered IDs without duplicates.","risk":"Mutable sorting fields invalidate this ordering guarantee."},{"action":"Return deleted IDs as explicit browse entries.","mechanism":"Tombstone entries preserve frozen membership even when record bodies disappear between requests.","implementation":"Retain ID, ordering fields, birth version, deletion version, and immutable filter fields for 24 hours. Deleted entries consume page slots.","check":"Delete unread members after page one. Their IDs must appear once as deleted entries; pre-watermark deletions must never appear.","risk":"Clients must handle deleted entries rather than silently discarding them."},{"action":"Expire cursors before required tombstones disappear.","mechanism":"Bounded session lifetimes make the membership promise compatible with finite deletion retention.","implementation":"Set a fixed ten-minute expiry at session creation. Sign W, boundary, filters, ordering, and expiry; reject expired cursors without silently restarting.","check":"A six-page, two-minute browse succeeds. Expired and modified cursors fail explicitly, including when deleted records have been purged.","risk":"Longer browsing requires an explicit restart, not seamless continuation."},{"action":"Consider an existing-store ID manifest instead.","mechanism":"Alternative: an immutable ordered ID list freezes membership without repeated historical membership queries.","implementation":"Within one request-scoped consistent read, persist ordered IDs in the existing store. Page by manifest position; expire after ten minutes.","check":"Enable only if capture, persistence, and response meet 300 ms under load. Concurrent mutations must not alter manifest IDs.","risk":"Capturing 80,000 IDs may exceed latency or storage budgets."},{"action":"Make duplicate and omission checks an executable oracle.","mechanism":"A reference membership set distinguishes correct browsing from merely duplicate-free output.","implementation":"Run randomized insert/delete schedules against captured membership. Compare six-page output with its expected prefix; also drain complete sessions against the full sequence.","check":"Assert ordered equality, unique ID count, and empty expected-minus-observed and observed-minus-expected sets for completed traversals.","risk":"Checking uniqueness alone misses omissions; partial sessions need prefix expectations."},{"action":"Gate deployment on worst-case indexed query behavior.","mechanism":"Seek pagination can still scan many excluded inserts or tombstones; an index alone does not establish latency.","implementation":"Inspect query plans and load-test 80,000 records with concurrent writes and retained tombstones. Add covering indexes for ordering and membership metadata.","check":"Measure end-to-end requests, including session creation and late pages; reject designs producing responses above 300 ms in the defined workload.","risk":"Benchmarks cannot guarantee latency under unspecified load; define supported concurrency."}],"abstention_reason":""}
